01 / Definition

Cognitive AI 研究的，
是答案发生的整段过程。

我们花了很长时间教机器回答问题，亦或执行任务。更大的问题刚刚浮现：在指令接受之时，机器理解了什么？在推理形成之中，它能否察觉自己的偏离？当输出离开屏幕、进入人的生活之后，它又把世界推向了哪里？

语言与场景只是认知短暂露出水面的部分。水面之下，有对他人意图的猜测、有权衡利弊的谋划、有无数推理路径在不确定性下收束。水面之外，行为参与现实，改变一个决定、一段关系，甚至一条原本不会发生的未来路径。

答案是 AI 时代的一点。认知从这里开始，并继续向未来发生。

02 / Research program

Before. During. After.

Cognitive AI expands the unit of intelligence from an output to a revisable, consequential trajectory.

Before the answer

Infer what is not said.

Model beliefs, desires, intentions, emotions, roles, and boundaries without confusing a hypothesis with a fact.

MetaMind ↗
Inside the answer

Find where thought diverges.

Expose intermediate cognition, test it against context and values, then roll back to the point where another path remains possible.

Cognition-of-Thought ↗
Beyond the answer

Follow what action changes.

Track latent state, event chains, relationships, institutions, and future choices across persistent interactive worlds.

WORLD·EOLOGY

04 / The name

The study of worlds as cognition and action continually remake them.

Worldeology begins from a simple claim: intelligence cannot be understood only inside a model. It must also be studied in the beliefs it changes, the relationships it enters, and the futures it makes reachable.
